metadata.description: Wealth 360: a wealth-servicing desk for relationship managers, run from Claude over the bank's own Salesforce.

plugins.name: wealth-360
plugins.description: Wealth 360 servicing desk over the Salesforce-hosted Wealth 360 MCP server (15 tools, per-user OAuth). Needs ONE connector named exactly "Wealth 360"; an optional second connector, "Wealth 360 Checks", runs sanctions, payee, address and identity checks from chat (sandbox). Two agents, a Case agent (maker) and a Review agent (independent check in a fresh context), work five servicing journeys: change of details, money out, money in, bereavement and complaints, in real time, with email intake and branded email. The relationship manager is the checker: every decision is staged, shown verbatim, confirmed by a named person and executed behind a single-use token. Agents can never approve or release; Salesforce refuses them.
